name: aoxn-ide
description: The Aoxn IDE — editor, project explorer and build runner for the Aoxn language

pnpm.//: monaco-editor pins dompurify to an EXACT version (3.4.15) and is itself at its latest release, so 3.4.16 only arrives through an override. The two IN_PLACE advisories (a node-removing afterSanitize hook leaving a detached subtree's handlers armed; a force-removed rawtext root whose text carries attacker markup) are XSS in the sanitiser Monaco uses for pasted/loaded HTML.
